Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: the newly approved fine-pixel garden atlas. In particular match the wood craft, tiny coherent pixel highlights, warm oak shading and thin dark edge work of its bench. Image 2 is the GEOMETRY REFERENCE: retain this desk's exact orthogonal elevated RPG silhouette and proportions, clear knee opening on left, two stacked drawers on right, empty tabletop, horizontal front edge. Do not copy image 2's flat oversized bands of color. Redraw it in the much richer, finer pixel modeling of image 1.
Important: preserve a broad shallow tabletop, thin front apron and three visible slim supports; full desk is approximately 138 units wide and 72 units high in the game. Native detail about 256x133 fine pixels; fine 1-2 native pixel contours like characters and the new garden bench. Warm honey oak, small orderly pixel grain strokes along planks, stepped bevel highlights, soft multi-tone wood shading made of carefully placed discrete pixels, small grey iron handles. Leg opening stays transparent/magenta and large. No chair, monitor, nameplate, papers, decorations or extra objects. No cast floor shadow. No ground. Camera unchanged, front edge horizontal, no isometric tilt or angled furniture.
Background perfectly solid RGB(255,0,255) magenta, also inside leg openings. Desk centered, fully visible, generous padding, one object only. No lettering, measurement labels, grid or borders. High quality deliberately hand-placed fine pixel art, matched to image 1. Avoid giant chunky pixels, thick black sticker outlines, smooth vector-like flat panels, gradients, painterly blur, noise, photorealism, 3D rendering. Deliver one single asset.
